name: solve-fastmap
description: GPU SfM (FastMap, STO-SCN-101) on a subset -> camera poses + a COLMAP sparse/0 (the co-visibility source). Fisheye is undistorted to pinhole first using the per-camera calibration (STO-SCN-102); pinhole/rectilinear goes straight in. Settings are produced by solve_plan from the capture profile (STO-SCN-091) + per-scene modality. Replaces COLMAP's CPU incremental mapper (operator directive: GPU-only). Sibling algo to mast3r-sfm@0 on the cameras shelf.

camera_model.note: post-undistort pinhole, or SIMPLE_RADIAL if no undistort

undistort.note: fisheye -> pinhole via the 102 calibration (transient host workdir, not persisted)

matcher.note: exhaustive for hyperlapse/wide-baseline; sequential for dense video (HUG-SCN-004)
